declare "imapserv_filter" {

    argument "logfilename" {}
    argument "log_receiver" {}

    loki.source.file "imapserv" {
        targets               = [{__path__ = argument.logfilename.value, "job" = "imapserv"}]
        forward_to            = [loki.process.imapserv.receiver]
        tail_from_end         = true
    }

    loki.process "imapserv" {
            forward_to = [loki.relabel.imapserv_drop_label.receiver]
            stage.regex {
            expression = "^(?P<year>\\d{4})(?P<month>\\d{2})(?P<day>\\d{2}).(?P<hour>\\d{2})(?P<min>\\d{2})(?P<sec>\\d{2})(?P<ms>\\d{3}).(?P<timezone>\\d{2}).{2}.(?P<hostname>[A-Za-z0-9-]+[-A-Za-z0-9]).{1}(?P<service>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<minor_pid>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<thread_id>[0-9]+).{1}(?P<log_level>[A-Za-z]+).{1}(?P<event>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\\([^)]*\\)\\s(?<kv_string>.*)$"
            }


         // Get date in format
        stage.template {
                source = "formatted_date"
            template = "{{.year}}-{{.month}}-{{.day}}T{{.hour}}:{{.min}}:{{.sec}}.{{.ms}}+{{.timezone}}:00"
            }
            stage.timestamp {
                source = "formatted_date"
                format = "2006-01-02T15:04:05.000Z07:00"
                action_on_failure = "skip"
            }

        stage.labels {
            values = {
                event = null,
            }
        }

        stage.match {
           //selector = "{event!~\"AcctUnknownUser|AcctInactive|AcctBadPswd|AcctImapNotAllowed|ImapConnTimedOut|NioRecvFail|SslHandshakeSucceeded|ImapMoveComplete|ImapDisconnected|ImapLogout|ImapConnMade|ImapProxyLoginFailed|ImapProxyConnMade|NioGetSockNameFail|MsgTrace|MsMessageReadFail|MsMsgIDNotFound|ImapProtocolErr|ImapCommandFailedReason|MsTooBusy|SslHandshakeFailed|NioSendError|UserDataException|ImapDataInconsistency|ImapMessageCountMismatch|SievePolicyLog|SievePolicyExecute|NioTimeOutWrite|NioTimeOutRead|AcctMaintenance|CassdbNoDataFoundError|ImapUIDOutOfOrder|CountersAccessError\"}"
           // 1st Phase: Ingest only logs available in ELK
           selector = "{event!~\"AcctUnknownUser|AcctInactive|AcctBadPswd|AcctImapNotAllowed|NioRecvFail|ImapMoveComplete|ImapConnMade|ImapProxyLoginFailed|ImapProxyConnMade|NioSendError|UserDataException|SievePolicyLog|AcctMaintenance|CountersAccessError\"}"
           action = "drop"
           drop_counter_reason = "non_essential_log"
        }

        stage.match {
            selector = "{event=~\"AcctUnknownUser|AcctInactive|AcctBadPswd|AcctImapNotAllowed|ImapConnTimedOut|NioRecvFail|SslHandshakeSucceeded|ImapMoveComplete|ImapDisconnected|ImapLogout|ImapConnMade|ImapProxyLoginFailed|ImapProxyConnMade|NioGetSockNameFail\"}"

            // Extract cmd
            stage.regex {
                expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
                source = "kv_string"
            }
            // Correct cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = ","
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\)"
               replace   = "\\\\"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\5c)"
               replace   = "\\"
            }
            // replace cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "kv_string"
               expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
               replace   = "{{ .cmd_val }}"
            }
            // Parse kv_string
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(:)"
                replace   = "\",\""
            }

            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(=)"
                replace   = "\":\""
            }
            stage.template {
                source = "json_kv_string"
                template = "{\"{{ .kv_string }}\"}"
            }
            stage.match {
                selector = "{event=~\"NioGetSockNameFail\"}"
                 stage.template {
                    source    = "kv_string"
                    template  = "message\": \"{{ .kv_string}}"
                }
            }

            stage.template {
                source = "formatted_event"
                template = "\"{{ .kv_string }}\""
            }
        }
        stage.match {
            selector = "{event=~\"NioTimeOutWrite|NioTimeOutRead|AcctMaintenance|CassdbNoDataFoundError|ImapProxyLoginFailed|ImapProxyConnMade|ImapUIDOutOfOrder\"}"
            stage.regex {
                source = "kv_string"
                expression = "^(?P<argument1>[^:]+).(?<argument2>[^:]+).(?<kv_string>[^\n]*)"
            }


            // Extract cmd
            stage.regex {
                expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
                source = "kv_string"
            }
            // Correct cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = ","
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\)"
               replace   = "\\\\"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\5c)"
               replace   = "\\"
            }
            // replace cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "kv_string"
               expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
               replace   = "{{ .cmd_val }}"
            }

            // Make it json
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(:)"
                replace   = "\",\""
            }

            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(=)"
                replace   = "\":\""
            }

            stage.template {
                source = "formatted_event"
                template = "\"argument1\": \"{{ .argument1 }}\", \"argument2\": \"{{ .argument2 }}\", \"{{ .kv_string }}\""
            }
        }
        stage.match {
            selector = "{event=~\"MsgTrace|MsMessageReadFail|MsMsgIDNotFound|ImapProtocolErr|ImapCommandFailedReason|ImapProxyLoginFailed|ImapProxyConnMade|MsTooBusy|SslHandshakeFailed|NioSendError|CountersAccessError\"}"
            stage.regex {
                source = "kv_string"
                expression = "^(?P<argument>[^:]+).(?P<kv_string>[^\n]+)"
            }


            stage.replace {
               source    = "argument"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }


            // Extract cmd
            stage.regex {
                expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
                source = "kv_string"
            }
            // Correct cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = ","
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\)"
               replace   = "\\\\"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\5c)"
               replace   = "\\"
            }
            // replace cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "kv_string"
               expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
               replace   = "{{ .cmd_val }}"
            }

            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(:)"
                replace   = "\",\""
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(=)"
                replace   = "\":\""
            }
            stage.template {
                source = "formatted_event"
                template = "\"argument\": \"{{ .argument }}\", \"{{ .kv_string }}\""
            }
        }
        stage.match {
            selector = "{event=~\"SievePolicyLog|SievePolicyExecute|ImapProxyLoginFailed|ImapProxyConnMade\"}"
            stage.regex {
                source = "kv_string"
                expression = "^(?P<argument>[^:]+).(?P<kv_string>[^\n]+)"
            }

            stage.replace {
               source    = "argument"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            // Extract cmd
            stage.regex {
                expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
                source = "kv_string"
            }
            // Correct cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = ","
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\)"
               replace   = "\\\\"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\5c)"
               replace   = "\\"
            }
            // replace cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "kv_string"
               expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
               replace   = "{{ .cmd_val }}"
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(:)"
                replace   = "\",\""
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(=)"
                replace   = "\":\""
            }
            stage.template {
                source = "formatted_event"
                template = "\"argument\": \"{{ .argument }}\", \"{{ .kv_string }}\""
            }
        }
        stage.match {
            selector = "{event=~\"ImapMessageCountMismatch\"}"
            stage.regex {
                source = "kv_string"
                expression = "^(?P<argument>[^:]+)..(?P<kv_string>[^\n]+)"
            }

            stage.replace {
               source    = "argument"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }

            // Extract cmd
            stage.regex {
                expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
                source = "kv_string"
            }
            // Correct cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = ","
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\)"
               replace   = "\\\\"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\5c)"
               replace   = "\\"
            }
            // replace cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "kv_string"
               expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
               replace   = "{{ .cmd_val }}"
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(:)"
                replace   = "\",\""
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(=)"
                replace   = "\":\""
            }
            stage.template {
                source = "formatted_event"
                template = "\"argument\": \"{{ .argument }}\", \"{{ .kv_string }}\""
            }
        }
        stage.match {
            selector = "{event=~\"ImapDataInconsistency\"}"
            stage.regex {
                source = "kv_string"
                expression = "^(?P<argument>[^:]+).(?P<ms_url>[^:]+).(?P<folderUUID>[^:]+).(?P<msgCount>[^:]+).(?P<kv_string>[^\n]+)"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "ms_url"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = "\\\\3a"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "argument"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = "\\\\3a"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "argument"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "argument"
               expression = "(\\\\5c)"
               replace   = "\\"
            }


            // Extract cmd
            stage.regex {
                expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
                source = "kv_string"
            }
            // Correct cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = ","
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\)"
               replace   = "\\\\"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\5c)"
               replace   = "\\"
            }
            // replace cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "kv_string"
               expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
               replace   = "{{ .cmd_val }}"
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(:)"
                replace   = "\",\""
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(=)"
                replace   = "\":\""
            }
            stage.template {
                source = "formatted_event"
                template = "\"argument\": \"{{ .argument }}\", \"ms_url\": \"{{ .ms_url }}\", \"folderUUID\": \"{{ .folderUUID }}\", \"msgCount\": \"{{ .msgCount }}\", \"{{ .kv_string }}\""
            }
        }
        stage.match {
            selector = "{event=~\"UserDataException\"}"
            stage.regex {
                source = "kv_string"
                //expression = "^(?P<errorCode>[^:]+).(?P<ReqParameters>[^:]+).(?<OpType>[^:]+).(?P<ShortMsg>[^:]+)..(?P<kv_string>.*)"
                expression = "^(?P<errorCode>[^:]+):(?P<ReqParameters>\\{[^}]+\\}):(?P<OpType>[^:]+):(?P<ShortMsg>.*?):(?P<kv_string>user=.*)"
            }

            // Extract cmd
            stage.regex {
                expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
                source = "kv_string"
            }
            // Correct cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\3a)"
               replace   = ","
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\")"
               replace   = ""
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\)"
               replace   = "\\\\"
            }
            stage.replace {
               source    = "cmd_val"
               expression = "(\\\\5c)"
               replace   = "\\"
            }
            // replace cmd
            stage.replace {
               source    = "kv_string"
               expression = "cmd=(?P<cmd_val>[^:]+)"
               replace   = "{{ .cmd_val }}"
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(:)"
                replace   = "\",\""
            }
            stage.replace {
                source    = "kv_string"
                expression = "(=)"
                replace   = "\":\""
            }
            stage.template {
                source = "formatted_event"
                template = "\"errorCode\": \"{{ .errorCode }}\", \"ReqParameters\": \"{{ .ReqParameters }}\", \"OpType\": \"{{ .OpType }}\", \"ShortMsg\": \"{{ .ShortMsg }}\", \"{{ .kv_string }}\""
            }
        }
        stage.match {
            selector = "{event=~\"AcctUnknownUser|AcctInactive|AcctBadPswd|AcctImapNotAllowed|ImapConnTimedOut|NioRecvFail|SslHandshakeSucceeded|ImapMoveComplete|ImapDisconnected|ImapLogout|ImapConnMade|ImapProxyLoginFailed|ImapProxyConnMade|NioGetSockNameFail|MsgTrace|MsMessageReadFail|MsMsgIDNotFound|ImapProtocolErr|ImapCommandFailedReason|MsTooBusy|SslHandshakeFailed|NioSendError|UserDataException|ImapDataInconsistency|ImapMessageCountMismatch|SievePolicyLog|SievePolicyExecute|NioTimeOutWrite|NioTimeOutRead|AcctMaintenance|CassdbNoDataFoundError|ImapUIDOutOfOrder|CountersAccessError\"}"

            stage.regex {
                source = "formatted_event"
                expression = "fromhost\":\"(?P<fromhost>[^\"]+)"
            }

            // Generate network_bucket from fromhost (/24 network)
            stage.template {
                source = "network_bucket"
                template = `
                    {{- if and .fromhost (regexMatch "^([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$" .fromhost) -}}
                        {{- $net := regexReplaceAll "^([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)\\.[0-9]+$" .fromhost "$1" -}}
                        {{ printf "%.1s" (Sha2Hash $net "") }}
                    {{- end -}}
                `
            }

            stage.labels {
                values = {
                    network_bucket = "network_bucket",
                }
            }

            stage.labels {
                values = {
                  fromhost = null,
                }
            }
            stage.match {
                selector = "{fromhost=~\".+\"}"
                stage.geoip {
                    db = "/etc/geoip-db/GeoLite2-Country.mmdb"
                    source  = "fromhost"
                    db_type = "country"
                }
                stage.geoip {
                    db = "/etc/geoip-db/GeoLite2-ASN.mmdb"
                    source  = "fromhost"
                    db_type = "asn"
                }
                stage.geoip {
                    db = "/etc/geoip-db/GeoLite2-City.mmdb"
                    source  = "fromhost"
                    db_type = "city"
                }
                stage.template {
                    source = "is_private_ip"
                    template = "{{ if regexMatch `^(10\\.|192\\.168\\.|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\\.)` .fromhost }}true{{ else }}false{{ end }}"
                }
                stage.template {
                    source = "geoip_country_code"
                    template = "{{ if eq .is_private_ip \"true\" }}GB{{ else }}{{ .geoip_country_code }}{{ end }}"
                }
                stage.template {
                    source = "geoip_city_name"
                    template = "{{ if eq .is_private_ip \"true\" }}OPWV_WEB{{ else }}{{ .geoip_city_name }}{{ end }}"
                }

                stage.template {
                    source = "geo_details"
                    template = "\"geoip_country_code\": \"{{ .geoip_country_code }}\", \"geoip_city_name\": \"{{ .geoip_city_name }}\", \"geoip_org\": \"{{ .geoip_autonomous_system_organization }}\""
                }

            }

            stage.regex {
                source = "formatted_event"
                expression = "cmd\":\"(?P<cmd>[^\"]+)"
            }
            stage.labels {
                values = {
                  cmd = null,
                }
            }
            stage.match {
               selector = "{cmd=~\".+\"}"
               stage.regex {
                   source = "cmd"
                   expression = "^(?P<imapTag>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\\s+(?P<imapCommand>[A-Za-z]+)"
               }
            }

            stage.template {
                source = "event_out"
                template = "{\"hostname\": \"{{ .hostname }}\", \"service\": \"{{ .service }}\", \"thread_id\": \"{{ .thread_id }}\", \"log_level\": \"{{ .log_level }}\", \"event\": \"{{ .event }}\", \"imaptag\":\"{{.imapTag}}\", \"imapcmd\":\"{{.imapCommand}}\", {{.formatted_event}}{{ if .geo_details }},{{ .geo_details }}{{ end }}}"
                }
                stage.replace {
                source     = "event_out"
                expression = "(\\\\)"
                replace    = "\\\\"
                }
                stage.replace {
                   source    = "event_out"
                   expression = "(\\\\3a)"
                   replace   = "\\3a"
                }
                stage.replace {
                   source    = "event_out"
                   expression = "(\\\\5c)"
                   replace   = "\\"
                }

                // Generate email_bucket from user ( exclude events to avoid bucket overloading)
                stage.match {
                    selector = "{event!~\"AcctUnknownUser|AcctImapNotAllowed\"}"
                    stage.json {
                        source = "event_out"
                        expressions = { user = "user" , }
                    }

                                        //hash only the user name by removing the .t1 and t2
                    stage.template {
                        source = "email_bucket"
                        template = `
                            {{- if .user -}}
                                {{- $username := index (splitList "@" (ToLower (printf "%s" .user))) 0 -}}
                                {{- $username = regexReplaceAll "(\\.t21|\\.t1)$" $username "" -}}
                                {{- printf "%.2s" (Sha2Hash $username "") -}}
                            {{- end -}}
                        `
                    }

                    stage.labels {
                        values = {
                            email_bucket = "email_bucket",
                        }
                    }
                                }
                // End of email_bucket code

                stage.output {
                    source = "event_out"
                }
        }
    }
    loki.relabel "imapserv_drop_label" {
       rule {
           action = "labeldrop"
           regex  = "filename|fromhost|cmd"
       }
       forward_to = argument.log_receiver.value
    }
}
